# Island Mountain AI Inc.

## About
Forward-deployed AI engineering for regulated organizations. Island Mountain AI Inc. embeds on-site, learns how an organization works from the people who run it, finds where AI genuinely helps, then assembles whatever configuration serves that and trains the team to run it. Everything runs on the customer's premises, air-gap capable, so no data leaves the building. They own the hardware and the models outright: no token fees, no subscription, no per-seat charges. California built.

## The Sequence
1. Immerse: an intense period on-site with senior employees, managers, and founders. Not a discovery deck.
2. Discover: mapping the use-cases and applications already latent in the organization, most of which nobody has articulated yet.
3. Configure: Basho recommends the stack purchase for what Discovery turned up, then it is deployed and configured together, on-site. Sized with room to grow.
4. Onboard: he onboards the customer's team to workflows and agentic orchestration built for their vertical and for what they actually sell or do. A deployment nobody can run is a very expensive shelf.

Discovery comes before configuration on purpose. Nobody can tell you what to buy before knowing what you would use it for.

## Configurations
There is no product line, no price list, and no set hardware specifications. Island Mountain AI Inc. will configure and deploy any hardware and software combination a customer needs. There is no standing catalog and no standing recommendation, because the recommendation does not exist until Discovery has shown what the organization actually does.

Scale is whatever the work calls for. A small business running a couple of desktop-class boxes and a few laptops is as real an answer as an enterprise estate on rack-mounted accelerators with adjacent data server racks. Neither is the upsell. Island Mountain also configures hardware it did not sell, including machines another integrator shipped and never set up.

Models are any open-source, open-weight model, swapped as the frontier moves, so no lab holds a meter and nobody can deprecate the model a workflow depends on. The serving stack is hardened Linux with the open inference tooling the deployment calls for, fully air-gap capable, with the Woven Security and Governance Fabric woven through. Every number comes from a quote scoped to the engagement after the work has been seen.

## Security Fabric (Lamprey)
Lamprey is a Woven Security & Governance Fabric - a software layer that secures and governs an organization from the outside through the cloud, or from the inside with air-gapped security. Cloud visibility, compliance evidence, and approval-gated remediation without standing privilege. Zero standing privilege: scan access is minted just in time, scoped to the operation, and revoked automatically.
- [Lamprey Woven Security & Governance Fabric](https://islandmountain.io/lamprey-woven-security-governance.html)

## Who This Is For
- Law firms protecting attorney-client privilege (ABA Model Rule 1.6)
- Medical practices needing HIPAA compliance without a BAA
- Defense contractors handling ITAR/CUI/CMMC-regulated data
- Tribal nations exercising data sovereignty (OCAP principles)
- Research labs protecting unpublished data and grant-funded IP
- Financial institutions complying with GLBA and PCI DSS
- Insurance carriers protecting policyholder PII and health data
- Energy and utility companies meeting NERC CIP and IEC 62443 requirements
- Government agencies handling CUI under FedRAMP and NIST SP 800-171
- Educational institutions protecting student records under FERPA
- Casino gaming operations complying with Title 31 BSA/AML, NIGC MICS, and state gaming commission cybersecurity requirements

## Team
- Basho Parks, Founder. Sole founder of Island Mountain AI Inc. He runs every deployment himself: the on-site immersion, Discovery, the stack recommendation, the deployment, and the onboarding. AI systems, prompt engineering, forward deployment, business development, and content. Background in tribal emergency management with the Yurok Tribe.
